chunks: We have bestowed Our favour on you before this
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'We have bestowed Our favour on you before this' in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the 'Covenant of Alast' or the primordial bestowal of prophethood upon Muhammad (peace be upon him), highlighting the continuity of divine favor before the major event of the Hijrah. It underscores the concept of God's persistent grace, reinforcing the Prophet's unique status and the spiritual lineage that precedes his public mission. This interpretation aligns with the broader Shia emphasis on the pre-existence of the Prophet's light and authority.
